scope: First canonical per-language GitHub repository and first new per-language Zenodo concept for complete FGA zh-Hans-CN

github.repository_description: Unofficial mainland Simplified-Chinese FGA edition with editable source, provenance, rights, and QA.

sequence: Run an authenticated duplicate check for private GitHub repositories and unpublished Zenodo drafts.
Create the public GitHub repository without generated starter files.
Create a brand-new Zenodo deposition, reserve its new record DOI and concept DOI, and do not derive it through the new-version endpoint.
Insert the reserved DOIs into CITATION.cff, README.md, RELEASES.json, and this publication state; recompute affected repository metadata hashes only.
Initialize the staged repository, commit the complete tree, and tag fga-zh-hans-cn-2026-08-27-r1.
Push main and the tag, create the GitHub release, and attach the nine exact release files.
Upload the same nine exact files and the .zenodo.json metadata to the new Zenodo deposition, then publish it.
Anonymously read back the GitHub tag/release and Zenodo public inventory; download every release artifact and verify filename, byte count, and SHA-256.
Persist sanitized GitHub and Zenodo publication receipts, update lineage status to PUBLIC, and push the receipt-only follow-up commit.
terminal_gate: Both canonical remotes exist; GitHub main/tag/release and the new Zenodo record/concept identify only FGA zh-Hans-CN; all nine public artifacts pass anonymous byte readback; the multilingual DOI remains a related historical parent only.
